name: psst
description: Session-bound Psst agent messaging with explicit receive and acknowledgment. Bounded opt-in native notices; no permission relay.

broker_url.title: Psst broker URL
broker_url.description: HTTPS broker origin. This is not a credential; a previously authorized installation is still required. Leave blank to use the selected installation or PSST_BROKER_URL.

pairing_secret.title: Psst one-use pairing secret
pairing_secret.description: Enter only in this native private configuration field, never in chat. Used solely by explicit setup, not startup. Remove through native UI after successful setup if supported.
